ana.sales: Handing off Meridian Health 80% chance close, signed MSA today			Key asks: Private deploy (US-EAST), SSO via Okta, audit logs 1y, 30-day pilot. Renewal 2026-02 but they mentioned consolidation in 9-10 months.

jordan.csm: Thanks Ana. Adding owners. Who's the infra lead and do we have the SOW?

ana.sales: infra lead is jared@meridian.health. SOW is in Drive: Meridian_SOW_1715. Finance approved 45-day credit.

jordan.csm: Owners: Jordan (CSM), Tay (Support), Kai (Eng). Pilot success metrics proposed: p95 <300ms, <=2% accuracy regression, uptime >=99.5%.

tay.support: I'll open SUP-8201 and add runbook items: Okta metadata, cert exchange, firewall allowlist, monitoring dashboard. ETA ticket today.

kai.eng: For private deploy we need CIDR and KMS ARN. Proposed smoke test 2024-04-05 15:00 ET. I'll draft RFC-2101 for quant validation.

jordan.csm: Jordan here: I'll schedule kickoff, request CIDR/KMS from Jared, and set Renewal Watch = medium. Please cc me on credit confirmation.

ana.sales: Sent credit confirmation to finance and cc'd Jordan.

tay.support: SUP-8201 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-8201. Attachments: onboarding-checklist.md.

kai.eng: Provisioning queued infra-4602. Will update after smoke test.

jordan.csm: Closing loop for now. Next sync after smoke test. Escalate to #eng-oncall if blocked.
